spots.name: Scratching the Surface - Mulheres do Mar
spots.blurb: You've reached Scratching the Surface - Mulheres do Mar, a mural by Alexandre Farto aka Vhils from 2020. Street art changes fast, so if the wall has been repainted, look around: the next piece is often close by.
